item.title: 'American Idol' contestant facing backlash after TPUSA unveils lineup for rival Super Bowl event
item.description: An “American Idol” contestant is facing backlash after Turning Point USA announced that the singer is among several entertainers performing at its All-American Halftime Show, which the conservative group is hosting as an alternative to the Super Bowl. #AmericanIdol #TPUSA #SuperBowl #halftimeshow #conservativemovement

item.title: ‘Still Hope’ tells story most sex trafficking films don’t: What healing looks like after rescue
item.description: Filmmaking duo Richie and Bethany Johns open up about their new film "Still Hope" and the work to provide healing for victims of sex trafficking. #RichieandBethanyJohns #StillHope #sextrafficking

item.title: Kanakuk Kamps threaten defamation lawsuit against Shawn Ryan over magnitude of sexual abuse
item.description: The embattled Kanakuk Kamps in Branson, Missouri, has threatened to file a defamation lawsuit against popular podcaster Shawn Ryan for having a guest on who claimed that “thousands” of children were sexually abused in their global network of Christian sports camps. Ryan has refused to back down from the claim. #KanakukKamps #ShawnRyan #SexualAbuse #Defamation #Lawsuit

item.title: Jonathan Roumie: 'Solo Mio' 'is ‘saving the rom-com,' bringing brotherhood back to big screen
item.description: At a moment when romantic comedies have been mainly relegated to streaming services or abandoned altogether in favor of increasingly raunchy plotlines, “The Chosen” star Jonathan Roumie believes his latest project, "Solo Mio," is “saving the rom-com.” #TheChosen #KevinJames #romcomJonathanRoumie

item.title: Mike Johnson says 'borders are biblical,' responds to Pope Leo's criticism of Trump policies
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., has responded to Pope Leo XIV’s concerns about President Donald Trump’s immigration policies, proclaiming that “borders are biblical.” #PopeLeoXIV #CatholicChurch #MikeJohnson #DonaldTrump #Immigration #Illegalimmigration

item.title: Faith-based organizations can now get funding for addiction recovery programs, HHS announces
item.description: U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. says faith-based organizations that meet evidence-based addiction recovery standards will now be able to access federal funding under the Trump administration’s new policy on tackling drug addiction and homelessness nationwide. #HHS #Faithbasedorganizations #Addiction #Recovery #RobertKennedy

item.title: 4 crazy posts on the new Reddit-style platform for AI agents: ‘Power doesn't announce itself'
item.description: It's not quite the AI apocalypse, but a new Reddit-style platform designed exclusively for AI agents is already raising questions about where the technology is headed. #AI #ArtificialIntelligence #Moltbot

item.title: Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir wins Grammy Award for ‘I Will Not Be Moved – Live’
item.description: The Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir won their seventh Grammy Award Sunday night as their 32nd album, “I Will Not Be Moved - Live,” was selected as the best roots gospel album of 2025 by the Recording Academy's voting members. #BrooklynTabernacleChoir #CarolCymbala #IWillNotBeMoved

item.title: American Society of Plastic Surgeons advises against sex-change surgeries for minors in new statement
item.description: The American Society of Plastic Surgeons is recommending that its members refrain from performing gender transition surgeries on minors amid an ongoing debate over the effectiveness and long-term impacts of such procedures. #LGBT #Transgender #AmericanSocietyofPlasticSurgeons #PennyYoungNance #ConcernedWomenforAmerica

item.title: Ryan Routh sentenced to life in prison for attempted assassination of Donald Trump
item.description: Ryan Routh, the man who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump in 2024 while the Republican politician was running for president, has been sentenced to life in prison. #RyanRouth #Trump #assassination #golfcourse #Florida #president #election
